Ministers Highlight 'Viksit Bharat' Vision for National Progress

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India is transforming challenges into opportunities on its path to becoming a 'Viksit Bharat' (developed India). Separately, Minister of Heavy Industries H.D. Kumaraswamy said Prime Minister Modi's vision for 'Viksit Bharat 2047' is driving India's electric mobility initiatives. Both ministers' remarks frame national development goals under the 'Viksit Bharat' umbrella.
